name: Greater Mend · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 7-block radius for 7.5 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heals 7.25 ❤
• Regeneration: +2 ❤ every 2 s for 18 s
• Growth: up to 20 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Heals 7.25 ❤
• Regeneration: +2 ❤ every 2 s for 18 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
